recipe.source: Modal best parameter configuration from Phase 3.1 TG2 nested CV.

handoff_to: Phase 3.2 — Model Evaluation, Versioning, and Promotion
important_limitations: Phase 3.1 development evidence has participated in challenger selection.
The official test set must not be used for additional challenger tuning.
A modest RMSE advantage does not by itself authorize production promotion.
No challenger fitted artifact has replaced the incumbent artifact.
phase31_conclusions: Default challenger families did not beat the incumbent during TG1 screening.
Bounded nested grouped-CV tuning made Extra Trees a credible challenger.
The fixed Extra Trees recipe retained nearly all of the tuned procedure's performance.
Engine-balanced weighting did not improve the declared primary pooled OOF RMSE and was therefore rejected.
The unweighted fixed Extra Trees recipe advances to Phase 3.2 for formal promotion evaluation.
phase31_decision: Advance the fixed unweighted Extra Trees challenger to Phase 3.2. Do not promote or alter serving during Phase 3.1.
